verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (GDHQ, Catalyze, the D&O Questionnaire Portal and the Contract Generator), so a telemetry opt-out question can fairly apply to those platforms. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. The data-privacy practice page describes legal services, not a product privacy setting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
